'''Jaro Dev''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During a mission on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], he was able to report that the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] are using a transmitter to disrupt the Republic's communications. He tasked a Republic spacer to destroy the pirates' comm system before they can move their base of operations.
